tour.replayBody: Seven steps to find your way: the pages, the cell, the grades and where your things live.

pages.title: Switch page
pages.body: This chip is your compass: open it to move between Scout, Map, Matrix and Ask.

select.title: Pick a category and a city
select.body: Tap the chips to open the flower, then pick a petal. You can also type a category or city name in the tags.

verdict.title: The verdict and the grades
verdict.body: Every cell gets a verdict and every number carries its grade. Hatched means insufficient data: never a low score.

sheet.title: The cell sheet
sheet.body: Six sections: market, territory, consumers, competition, opportunity and sources. Every figure opens its source, date and method.

mos.title: Opportunity
mos.body: The MOS (Market Opportunity Score) sums up how much room there is to enter. It takes you to the matrix in MOS mode; from there, open the opportunity ranking and move the weights.

ask.title: Ask
ask.body: Ask a question in Italian or English. Answers only use figures with their citation; if a figure is missing, it says so.

profile.title: Your space
profile.body: Here you find briefs, the product passport and settings: that is where you download your data and replay this tour any time.
